Generate a Qualtrics Import File for the HiTOP-DAT

Source: R/generate_qualtrics.R
generate_qualtrics_hitopdat.Rd

Creates a text file formatted for the Qualtrics Advanced Format import tool containing the 382 items of the HiTOP Digital Assessment and Tracker (HiTOP-DAT) battery. The item questions are hdat_001 to hdat_382 in battery order (hitopdat_items$Item), each a single-answer multiple-choice question whose choices are the values and labels of the item's own answer set (hitopdat_choices). Each answer carries its scoring value from hitopdat_choices$Value as its Qualtrics recode value, written in the file as the answer's [[Choice:<value>]] tag. With include_instructions = TRUE, each measure that has instruction text opens with a descriptive text question holding it: six of the seven measures, all but the CAPE. That question's ID is <id_prefix>_<measure>_instructions, where <measure> is the measure's name in lower case with each run of other characters made _ (hdat_whodas_instructions, hdat_idas_ii_instructions). Each measure after the first starts a new page.

Usage

generate_qualtrics_hitopdat(
  file = "hitopdat_qualtrics.txt",
  block_name = "HiTOP-DAT",
  id_prefix = "hdat",
  include_instructions = TRUE,
  breaks = 15
)

Arguments

file

Character string specifying the output file path. Defaults to "hitopdat_qualtrics.txt".

block_name

Character string specifying the name of the block in Qualtrics. Defaults to "HiTOP-DAT".

id_prefix

Character string specifying the prefix for the question IDs. Defaults to "hdat".

include_instructions

Logical. If TRUE (default), includes each measure's instruction text as a descriptive text question.

breaks

Integer or NULL. The number of items of a measure to display before inserting a page break, counted from the start of each measure. Set to 0 or NULL to break pages only between measures. Defaults to 15.

Value

Invisibly returns the path to the created file (file).

See also

generate_docx_hitopdat() and generate_redcap_hitopdat() for the Word forms and the REDCap import file. Step-by-step import instructions for Qualtrics and REDCap: https://jmgirard.github.io/hitop/articles/import-instructions.html

Examples

# Write a HiTOP-DAT Qualtrics import file to a temporary location
generate_qualtrics_hitopdat(file = tempfile(fileext = ".txt"))
#> ✔ Qualtrics import file successfully created at /tmp/RtmpIYUd8a/file19bc7a18ad59.txt
